articles.summary: Dallas, Texas, April 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — CompX International Inc. (NYSE American: CIX) announced today that, subject to the completion of quarter-end closing procedures, it expects to report first quarter 2026 earnings in a press release after market close on Tuesday, May 5, 2026. ...
articles.title: COMPX ANNOUNCES EXPECTED FIRST QUARTER 2026 EARNINGS RELEASE DATE
